title: Complicated - data pack
description: Mid-Tier Challenge Pack that aims to Rework Minecraft's Progression, Entirely! Using recipes and custom items involved. Which includes furnaces, stonecutter, Smithing table and etc which are needed to the lengthier progress.
body:
Video coming soon...

**intro:**
- This pack is a Mid-Teir Challenge Pack that makes progression not feel as funneled or one way. By making players use more work stations and use more materials found across the world.
- Also includes a rework of the entire recipe system of minecraft. This basicly makes this a overhaul of all recipes I can remember.
- It makes early game a bit more complex by adding more workbech items like campfires and other stuff involved. Pretty much tries to make early and mid game way harder and make end game more rewarding including custom items as secrets.
- Not all items in game may be accessable so I guess treat it like alternate minecraft if took another path. Somewhat fun isnt it?

- It is HIGHLY-RECOMMENDED for first timers to use (/recipe give @s *) to unlock and learn all recipes since many require explaining or getting use too to undertstand.

(this is my first public project plz be patient ><)

NOTICE: SPOILERS the pack is best played when you know NOTHING like when we first remember minecraft for the first time ^^ so please refrain until absolutely nessacry.

Gameplay Demo
https://www.youtube.com/live/9uXAyL3oajI?si=k46eMgPIVJrxq-s3

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*
**Early game spoilers:**
- Make a hatchet with string and flint to prepare logs for turning to wood. To get sticks just break leaves or break down a sapling. 
- Creating a crafting table is a bit more complicated and needs some leather to make a softer platform. Make a campfire to bake bricks into early tools for mining. 
"PLP"
"LPL" 
"PLP" Campfire recipe cus its annoying srry (was learning might change later ><)
- Allows any explorer to defend and keep moving for the long haul. Oh yea, place clay on the fire to cook the bricks they dry fast.

*
**Mid:game spoilers:**
- Make a furnace with the bricks leave no space when placing its cobblestone besides the bottom. It must be supported with bricks.
Most of the items from here on out need some creative thinking.
- You must cook what all players need to start their journey twice."
- Smoker? what that thing I bearly use yes might need to start expiramenting there.
Note: you cant make a bucket to cheese the portal anymore. But you can find things in structures since they are always free.
 -Create a smithing table by surrounding an iron block in cobbled deepslate to create.
Pickaxes are your progession to late game. After getting the wooden pick from the hints. Go create a copper one by upgrading it in the smithing table with 2 copper blocks (figure out how to make those :3c) same with iron pick with 2 iron blocks and diamond.

**End Game spoilers:**
- Ender eye look at the gallery thats your recipe minus the eye in center its was suppost to be a pearl. Tested like 4 versions all worked so it works.
- Netherite is the most expensive by far now. 4 gold blocks and 4 ancient debris with a lapis block in center. All to make one ingot. You need to do that TWICE for one upgrade.
Good news though after the upgrade your items become God teir. As they obtain immunity to being broken. (I think armour being worked on dunno might change someone please tell me later)


It does simplify wood to be only one type just to let you know.

Anyways thats the data pack hope everyone has a great time relearning minecarft again great for a longer than expected run of minecraft.

P.s. Did i forget this started when I had hyperfocus for 10 hours through the night? Yea its why its rushed. Ill update it whenever I get more ideas really.
